QUOTE: Without asm it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a global `volatile` set to 0 (`library/constant_time.c:29`), so the compiler must load it at run time.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that without asm, `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` XORs with the volatile global `mbedtls_ct_zero`, which is set to 0. That is the same function falling back to the XOR with a zero-holding global, and the global is named. It doesn't use the word "extern".
